Delete your data

Last updated: 1 November 2026

You are in control of your data. Here is how to remove it.

Quick way to remove a connected account: open the app, press the connected account (YouTube, Facebook or Instagram) in the top bar, then Disconnect. We delete the stored login tokens and account details straight away.

Delete your whole account and data

  1. Send an email to marketectify@gmail.com with the subject Delete my data, from the email address you use to sign in.
  2. We confirm your request and delete your account, posts, pictures, messages and connected-account details.
  3. This is done within 30 days (usually much sooner). We email you when it is finished.

Also remove our access on the platform

  • Google / YouTube: myaccount.google.com/permissions, choose the app, then Remove access.
  • Facebook: Settings & privacy, Settings, Business Integrations (or Apps and Websites), select the app, then Remove. You can tick the option to delete the posts and data the app created.
  • Instagram: Settings, Website permissions (or Apps and websites), then remove the app.

When you remove the app on Facebook or Instagram, we delete the data we hold for that account when we receive the notice or when you ask us by email.

See the Privacy Policy for what we store.
